PDF.js 5.6.205 (pdfjs-dist), Mozilla and contributors, Apache-2.0.
Vendored from `legacy/build/` in the pdfjs-dist npm distribution. The paired legacy bundles provide runtime compatibility shims for PDF image and worker operations. See LICENSE.
Upstream: https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js

Both module and worker are served locally and included in the dev offline shell.
No CDN, remote worker, OCR, analytics or upload service is used.
